title: Dark mode darkens every surface while the PDF always renders light
preconds: 1. You can switch the application to dark mode..
steps:
1. Switch to dark mode and review the page background, toolbar, header cells, customer rows, asset/invoice rows, and totals row.
2. While still in dark mode, download the PDF and open it.
expected:
1. In dark mode every visual rule applies with the dark equivalent of each color (dark background, dark surfaces).
2. The PDF export always renders in light-mode colors regardless of the user's app mode.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S20-R18), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-da72171 on 8/19/2026.
